hypotheses.K0_panels_are_fresh_and_task_blind_befor: The two FineWeb panels are disjoint, and semantic labels enter only the declared residualization stage, not site selection.
hypotheses.K1_declared_features_explain_substantial: Current-plus-next 50-feature labels and position explain at least 0.25 held-out write variance in at least three layers.
hypotheses.K2_exact_current_token_is_not_a_complete: Exact current-token lookup explains less than 0.75 held-out write variance in every layer.
hypotheses.K3_residual_subspaces_recur: After removing the declared feature model, rank-16 residual subspace overlap is at least 0.70 in at least three layers.
hypotheses.K4_residual_coordinates_add_material_cov: A frozen rank-64 residual subspace improves total held-out write R2 over the declared feature prediction by at least 0.20 in every layer.
hypotheses.K5_stable_residual_axes_exist: At least four individual residual PCA axes match across panels at absolute cosine at least 0.75.
hypotheses.K6_residual_axes_escape_the_declared_voc: At least half of selected stable axes have no current- or next-feature AUROC above 0.75 on replication.
hypotheses.K7_late_known_plus_residual_code_is_comp: At L17, declared-feature prediction plus a rank-16 residual subspace reaches at least 0.90 held-out write R2.
